title: 焚化爐爐排燃燒控制~Grate-combustion control in waste incinerators
focus: 以熱量、料床停留與排放證據理解爐排燃燒控制~Understand grate combustion through heat input, bed residence and emission evidence
summary: 本課以「以熱量、料床停留與排放證據理解爐排燃燒控制」為主軸，依序處理垃圾熱值與負荷邊界、爐排速度與物料停留、煙氣污染質量通量、整合煙氣處理績效、毛發電與淨效益。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Understand grate combustion through heat input, bed residence and emission evidence, progressing through Waste heating value and load boundary, Grate motion and material residence, Flue-gas pollutant mass rate, Integrated flue-gas treatment performance, Gross generation and net benefit. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 垃圾熱值與負荷邊界~Waste heating value and load boundary
units.mechanism: 將濕基進料、含水率及熱值連結，從源頭解釋蒸汽與煙氣波動。 燃料熱輸入由濕基進料量與對應低位熱值決定；相同噸數可能帶入不同熱量。~Link wet feed, moisture and heating value to explain steam and flue-gas fluctuations at the source. Fuel heat input is wet feed multiplied by its corresponding lower heating value; equal tonnage can carry different heat input.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基進料 m=2000 kg/h；假設低位熱值 LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 P=m*LHV/3600，計算得 4.44444 MW。適用邊界：平均熱值與穩態完全燃燒上限；不包含未燃損失及輔助燃料。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet-feed rate m=2000 kg/h; assumed lower heating value LHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula P=m*LHV/3600 gives 4.44444 MW. Applicability: Mean heating value and a steady complete-combustion input estimate; unburned losses and auxiliary fuel are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」，依代表性分樣求含水與熱值，和料重、蒸汽負荷及未燃分交叉檢查。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Waste heating value and load boundary, Use representative samples for moisture and heating value, cross-checking feed mass, steam load and unburned residue. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只控制質量流率而忽略含水與熱值，會造成熱負荷波動。 在「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Mass-flow control alone misses heat-load changes caused by moisture and heating value. Mark where this error can enter the Waste heating value and load boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 每天處理噸數相同就代表爐內熱輸入完全相同。~Equal daily tonnage guarantees identical furnace heat input.
units.practice: 只將 LHV 改成 6 MJ/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4.44444 變成 3.33333 MW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only LHV to 6 MJ/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4.44444 to 3.33333 MW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 一次與二次空氣的功能~Primary and secondary air roles
units.mechanism: 一次空氣穿過料床，二次空氣協助氣相混合；總量與分配必須分開評估。 實際空氣量為理論空氣量乘過量係數；更多空氣也增加煙氣及熱損失。~Primary air passes through the bed while secondary air supports gas mixing; assess totals separately from distribution. Actual air is stoichiometric air times the excess-air ratio; more air also increases flue-gas flow and heat loss.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：理論需氧量 O=800 kg/h；空氣氧分率 x=0.232；假設過量空氣比 λ=1.4。公式 air=lambda*O/x，計算得 4827.59 kg/h。適用邊界：元素氧需求已知且混合理想的紙上比較；不是燃燒控制設定。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Stoichiometric oxygen O=800 kg/h; air oxygen mass fraction x=0.232; assumed excess-air ratio λ=1.4. Formula air=lambda*O/x gives 4827.59 kg/h. Applicability: Known elemental oxygen demand and ideal mixing for a paper comparison, not a combustion-control setting.
units.verify: 針對「一次與二次空氣的功能」，同時比對氧氣、一氧化碳與溫度；分辨整體缺氧和局部混合不足。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Primary and secondary air roles, Compare oxygen, carbon monoxide and temperature together to separate global oxygen shortage from local poor mixing. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 總氧量足夠但配風不均，仍可能產生局部未燃區。 在「一次與二次空氣的功能」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sufficient total oxygen with poor distribution can still leave locally unburned zones. Mark where this error can enter the Primary and secondary air roles flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 煙氣氧含量越高，燃燒品質就一定越好。~Higher flue-gas oxygen always means better combustion.
units.practice: 只將 λ 改成 1.6，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4827.59 變成 5517.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only λ to 1.6, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4827.59 to 5517.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 爐排速度與物料停留~Grate motion and material residence
units.mechanism: 以動畫追蹤乾燥、燃燒與燃盡區，料床厚度和滑移會改變實際停留。 移動料床的名目停留時間取決於路徑與速度；翻動和滑移使個別顆粒不同。~Track drying, combustion and burnout zones in animation; bed depth and slip alter actual residence. Nominal moving-bed residence depends on path and speed; mixing and slip give particles different histories.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：有效路徑 L=6 m；平均移動速度 v=0.10 m/min。公式 t=L/v，計算得 60 min。適用邊界：一維平均速度近似，不代表燃盡、熟化或實際設備速度。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Effective path L=6 m; mean travel speed v=0.10 m/min. Formula t=L/v gives 60 min. Applicability: One-dimensional mean-speed approximation; it does not establish burnout, maturity or an equipment setting.
units.verify: 針對「爐排速度與物料停留」，以標記粒子或數位重播比較前緣與尾端到達時間，記錄速度分布。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Grate motion and material residence, Use marked particles or digital replay to compare leading and trailing arrival times and record speed spread. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 用機構速度代替物料速度，可能低估回混與滯留。 在「爐排速度與物料停留」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using mechanism speed as material speed can miss back-mixing and hold-up. Mark where this error can enter the Grate motion and material residence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 輸送機構移動速度必定等於每顆物料的移動速度。~Mechanism speed necessarily equals every particle velocity.
units.practice: 只將 v 改成 0.12 m/min，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變成 50 min。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only v to 0.12 m/min, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 60 to 50 min. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 含水進料的熱需求~Heating demand of wet feed
units.mechanism: 高含水垃圾先消耗熱量升溫，並增加後續蒸發負荷，不能直接視為有效燃料。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。~Wet waste first absorbs sensible heat and adds evaporation demand; it is not all useful fuel. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW. Applicability: Constant heat capacity, no phase change and steady flow; not a complete equipment heat balance.
units.verify: 針對「含水進料的熱需求」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Heating demand of wet feed, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「含水進料的熱需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Heating demand of wet feed flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 水分蒸發的能量已完全包含在固定比熱乘溫差內。~Evaporation energy is fully included in constant heat capacity times temperature rise.
units.practice: 只將 ΔT 改成 50 K，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變成 150 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ΔT to 50 K, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 120 to 150 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 煙氣污染質量通量~Flue-gas pollutant mass rate
units.mechanism: 將濃度與同基準氣量組合，辨認稀釋變化和真正污染負荷變化。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Combine concentration with matched gas flow to distinguish dilution from pollutant-load changes. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「煙氣污染質量通量」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Flue-gas pollutant mass rate, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「煙氣污染質量通量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Flue-gas pollutant mass rate flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 氧校正與比較基準~Oxygen normalization and comparison
units.mechanism: 在數位報表分開顯示原始與校正濃度，避免配風改變引起的表面改善。 氧校正比較固定參考氧濃度下的稀釋程度，不能與乾濕基校正混為一項。~Show raw and normalized concentrations separately to avoid apparent improvement caused only by airflow changes. Oxygen correction normalizes dilution to a reference oxygen concentration and is separate from moisture correction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾基濃度 C=50 mg/Nm³；量測 O₂=10%；假想參考 O₂ref=11%。公式 Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2)，計算得 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。適用邊界：以 21% 空氣氧近似且氧測值遠低於 21%；參考值僅為算例，不聲稱適用法規。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry concentration C=50 mg/Nm³; measured O₂=10%; hypothetical reference O₂ref=11%. Formula Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2) gives 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Applicability: Approximate air oxygen at 21%, with measured oxygen well below it; the reference is illustrative, not a legal claim.
units.verify: 針對「氧校正與比較基準」，保存原始濃度、含濕與 O₂，再重算每項校正，防止對已校正數據重複校正。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Oxygen normalization and comparison, Retain raw concentration, moisture and O₂ and recompute corrections to avoid double normalization. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「氧校正與比較基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Near ambient oxygen the denominator is small and minor oxygen errors amplify strongly. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen normalization and comparison flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 氧校正能消除任何煙道漏氣與取樣代表性的問題。~Oxygen correction eliminates every leakage and sampling-representativeness problem.
units.practice: 只將量測 O₂ 改成 12%，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45.4545 變成 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only measured O₂ to 12%, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 45.4545 to 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 整合煙氣處理績效~Integrated flue-gas treatment performance
units.mechanism: 燃燒與末端防制共同影響出口，需比較入口負荷、出口濃度與殘渣去向。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。~Combustion and downstream control jointly determine discharge; compare inlet loads, outlet levels and residue destinations. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inlet concentration Cin=100 mg/m³; outlet Cout=12 mg/m³. Formula eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100 gives 88 %. Applicability: Matched moisture, temperature, pressure and flow; removal percentage does not replace an outlet-emission assessment.
units.verify: 針對「整合煙氣處理績效」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Integrated flue-gas treatment performance, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「整合煙氣處理績效」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Integrated flue-gas treatment performance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 去除率很高就能證明出口濃度符合任何排放標準。~High removal efficiency proves compliance with every outlet-emission limit.
units.practice: 只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 88 變成 80 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 88 to 80 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 風量阻力與引風~Draft and gas-path resistance
units.mechanism: 爐膛至煙道的差壓變化可能來自積灰或流量；用兩種訊號區分原因。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。~Pressure-drop changes along the furnace-to-stack path may reflect deposits or flow; distinguish causes with both signals. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
units.verify: 針對「風量阻力與引風」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Draft and gas-path resistance, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「風量阻力與引風」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Draft and gas-path resistance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要差壓上升，就能確定濾材一定破損。~A higher differential pressure proves the filter medium is damaged.
units.practice: 只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 毛發電與淨效益~Gross generation and net benefit
units.mechanism: 燃燒最佳化須連同引風、送風與加藥輔機用電評估，不能只最大化蒸汽量。 淨輸出必須扣除系統內輔機；邊界決定哪些用電應納入。~Evaluate combustion together with draft, air and dosing auxiliaries rather than maximizing steam alone. Net output subtracts internal auxiliaries; the chosen system boundary determines which loads belong in the account.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：毛發電 Eg=1200 kWh/d；風機 Ef=160 kWh/d；泵 Ep=90 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ef-Ep，計算得 950 kWh/d。適用邊界：同一日與同一電表邊界，未計外購熱和建造能耗。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gross generation Eg=1200 kWh/d; fans Ef=160 kWh/d; pumps Ep=90 kWh/d. Formula Enet=Eg-Ef-Ep gives 950 kWh/d. Applicability: Same day and metering boundary; purchased heat and embodied construction energy are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「毛發電與淨效益」，用分表與主表核對電量和，避免把外部用戶用電算作設備損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Gross generation and net benefit, Reconcile submeters with the main meter and avoid charging external users to equipment losses. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只報毛發電會掩蓋高阻力、低效率輔機的影響。 在「毛發電與淨效益」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Reporting gross generation hides energy penalties from high-resistance, inefficient auxiliaries. Mark where this error can enter the Gross generation and net benefit flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 毛發電量就是可售出的淨電量。~Gross generation equals net electricity available for export.
units.practice: 只將 Ef 改成 220 kWh/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 950 變成 890 kWh/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Ef to 220 kWh/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 950 to 890 kWh/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 異常事件重播與可用率~Upset replay and availability
units.mechanism: 在離線模型重播進料突然改變，追蹤警報先後與恢復過程；不傳送任何真實設備指令。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Replay abrupt feed changes offline and trace alarm order and recovery; no real equipment commands are transmitted. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「異常事件重播與可用率」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Upset replay and availability, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「異常事件重播與可用率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Upset replay and availability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
